diagnosis: The developer application credentials route uses a fallback global HS256 secret shared across all developer tenants. Any tenant with access to the developer SDK secret can sign a JWT with arbitrary subject or appId, allowing them to retrieve API keys, client secrets, and webhook keys of any application on the platform.
